name: Tag wall drift
looks: A dense wall of small rounded pills, each naming a different topic or skill, fills the frame in several rows and drifts sideways at a slow steady speed, rows moving at slightly different speeds. A bold headline sits perfectly still on top of the drift.
build: Pills are a repeating, looped row (x wraps modulo total width); each row's speed is a small uneven multiple of a base rate for parallax; the headline is a fixed layer above with a soft shadow or translucent backing to stay legible.
sound: A soft, continuous low shimmer under the drift, with no individual hits.
prompt: Fill the frame with several rows of small pill tags drifting sideways at slightly different speeds, with a bold, perfectly still headline held over the top, so the drifting wall reads as breadth and depth behind one claim.
